A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 24-page versions of the same CaliDist paper, including Appendices A–K. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports original calibration experiments across six LLMs, benchmark comparisons, ablations, and additional ContractNLI and GSM8K evaluations, including results in Tables 1–11.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including the main benchmark comparisons and the smaller-model and GSM8K results in Appendices J–K.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same distractor generation, prediction and confidence instability measures, reliability score, validation-based normalization, and sigmoid confidence scaling. No method component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same seven primary benchmarks: MSciNLI, MNLI, PPDB, Yahoo Answers, HellaSwag, CSQA, and AQuA. The ContractNLI case study and GSM8K evaluation are also present in both.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments. The retained comparisons include Temperature Scaling, self-consistency, entropy, FSD, vanilla/verbalized confidence, SPUQ, Vector Scaling, and Isotonic Regression.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendices D and G–I retain the same sample counts, validation procedure, six model configurations, confidence elicitation, decoding settings, and 15-pass consistency baselines. Evaluation metrics and ablation protocols are unchanged.

E4.justification: The sigmoid-tuning, cross-domain transfer, AUROC, confidence-instability formulation, distractor-count, and validation-size analyses are retained without revision. The ContractNLI case study and appendix analyses are not new additions in v2.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical. Neither version reports experimental repeat counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or formal significance tests; the statement about statistically indistinguishable tuning parameters in Appendix I.1 is also unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–11 and the plotted findings match. For example, Table 11 reports the same CaliDist GSM8K ECE values in both versions: 5.51 for Llama-3.1 and 4.28 for Qwen-3.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations in Section 3, Appendix B's sigmoid and Platt-scaling reasoning, and Appendix C's illustrative calculations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about behavioral robustness, accuracy-preserving calibration, white-box and black-box applicability, and calibration improvements. The abstract's claimed average ECE reduction from 23% to 7% is unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations of instability as a reliability signal, qualifications concerning proprietary models' verbalized confidence, and the discussion of larger-model applicability remain unchanged. Appendix J–K interpretations are retained despite pagination shifts.

D1.justification: The abstract changes the advertised code/data repository from github.com/m-anas-j/CaliDist to github.com/anas-jawad/CaliDist. Prompts, hardware, implementation details, and tuning instructions are otherwise unchanged. The PDFs do not establish any change in repository contents or availability.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the bibliography retain the same cited works and research positioning, including comparisons with temperature scaling, consistency methods, SPUQ, SteerConf, and Bayesian approaches.

P1.justification: Front-page text changes are limited to the repository address and the arXiv version/date stamp, from v1 dated 4 June 2026 to v2 dated 4 August 2026. Scientific prose, terminology, section order, and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Appendix pages 21–24 have adjusted spacing and page breaks. Both hyperparameter-search bullets now appear on page 22, Table 9 and Figure 5 shift downward, and Appendix K starts on page 24 instead of page 23. No figures or tables are added, removed, or substantively redrawn.

improvement.justification: v2 updates the repository pointer and makes small appendix layout adjustments while retaining all scientific arguments, results, theory, and limitations. These edits establish no meaningful net quality difference; the PDFs do not demonstrate improved code/data availability or additional reproducibility support.
